_about: What the issuers publish now: certifications, course certificates and badges in AI, data, cybersecurity, cloud and IT, from the tech giants and the certifying bodies. The registries (CareerOneStop, Credential Engine) lag the issuers by a year or more on AI credentials; this file closes that gap. kb/_build_it_ai_credential_catalog.py reads the verified rows. The industry-credential watch agent keeps it current (docs/reference/credential_watch_agent.md): it re-verifies rows, adds new credentials, and marks retirements. It never deletes a row -- a retired credential is still evidence a student holds.
_verified_by: The credential catalog session, 2026-09-30: research agents reading issuer pages and search results that quote them. Sam Lee asked for it: 'I am interested in all certs, but particularly emerging ones from the tech giants' and 'Not just certs, but courses that result in badges or certs as well.' Weekly watch run 2026-10-12: direct reads of learn.microsoft.com, aws.amazon.com, nvidia.com, comptia.org and credly.com; openai.com and anthropic.com did not resolve. Weekly watch run 2026-10-19: direct reads of learn.microsoft.com, aws.amazon.com and nvidia.com. Weekly watch run 2026-10-26: direct reads of learn.microsoft.com and claude.com. Nightly watch run 2026-11-02 (the first nightly slice: Google, Microsoft, Amazon Web Services, IBM, Oracle, Cisco, NVIDIA): direct reads of cloud.google.com, grow.google, learn.microsoft.com and its public catalog API, aws.amazon.com, docs.aws.amazon.com, oracle.com, cisco.com, nvidia.com, skillsbuild.org, comptia.org, databricks.com and eccouncil.org; IBM's certification list read from IBM's own Credly organization listing.
_method_caveat: Most rows were confirmed from search results quoting the issuer's page. The environment's network policy blocked direct fetches of aws.amazon.com, docs.aws.amazon.com, learn.microsoft.com, grow.google, coursera.org, credly.com, comptia.org and nvidia.com on 2026-09-30, and the session's 200 web searches ran out before every row was re-checked. 'evidence' names what was seen. Confirm a row on the issuer's own page before a college relies on it; rows with verified=false are held out of the catalog until a run confirms them. 2026-10-12: Microsoft, AWS, NVIDIA, CompTIA and Credly pages now load directly; openai.com, anthropic.com and academy.claude.com do not resolve. 2026-11-02: www.ibm.com/training renders only in a browser, so IBM certifications were read from IBM's Credly listing and stay verified=false; skillbuilder.aws, blogs.oracle.com and blogs.cisco.com were refused by the network; education.oracle.com redirects to oracle.com, which loads.
_issuers_source: The research agents' issuer list, plus Anthropic and OpenAI from Sam's own watchlist (CPLBrain 03-professional/COMPETITIVE-WATCHLIST.md). A run re-reads that watchlist and adds any AI certification provider it names.
